title: Cloudflare Web Analytics authentication and configuration/rule read-access prerequisite

baseline.head: b279a0cd62c5bf0d8a2b459d41312f4d3d8aa94b
baseline.worktree: Clean and empty index before diagnosis

priorBlocker: ZK2 GET account RUM site list returned HTTP 401; no rules obtained or analytics mutation performed.

authentication.mechanism: Wrangler OAuth stored access token, directly reused by PowerShell API requests without Wrangler refresh
authentication.scopeMeaning: Locally stored historical OAuth scope names only, not fresh effective API-token permissions or account resource policy. Do not map account:read automatically to Account Settings Read.
authentication.wranglerStatusBasis: No whoami or login run: installed source exposes identity details and auth/account paths may refresh expired credentials and write storage. Refresh credential presence does not prove refresh success or current Wrangler authentication.
authentication.environmentBasis: No CLOUDFLARE* or CF_* variable names observed in execution process; no values emitted. No claim about other processes or persistent user environments.
authentication.directApiAuthenticated: NO — existing access token is expired and read probes were denied
authentication.sourceCategory: User-local Wrangler default TOML credential store outside repository
authentication.resourceScope: UNKNOWN — correct/all/different account or zone grant cannot be established from local scope names.

priorRequest.structuralValidity: Correct scheme and current documented site-list endpoint; token present; no evidence of malformed header
priorRequest.classification: STRUCTURALLY CORRECT; expired stored OAuth reused without refresh
priorRequest.rulesetId: Never obtained; site-list discovery denied before selecting a site/ruleset. No fabricated ruleset ID or rules-list request.

rootCause.evidence: Stored expiry precedes client date and execution time; prior direct request bypassed Wrangler refresh. Current /user and intended-account probes returned HTTP 403, confirming no usable read access.
rootCause.limits: Expiry directly established; API responses alone do not prove the sole rejection cause. Further endpoint/permission issues may remain after separately authorized restoration.

probes.identity: Not established; no response identity or personal fields recorded

wranglerVsDirect: Same user-local OAuth credential source; no separate environment token detected. Direct API reused stale access token; Wrangler source supports refresh/store but current refreshed Wrangler success was deliberately not tested. No claim that Wrangler is currently authenticated.

apiDocumentation.mutationPermission: Account Settings Write — INFORMATION ONLY / NOT AUTHORIZED
apiDocumentation.dataVsConfiguration: Zone Analytics Read/data access is not evidence of Web Analytics configuration/rule access.
apiDocumentation.siteDiscoveryCapability: Official response includes site configuration, auto_install and rules; can provide authoritative initial read without requesting write.
apiDocumentation.rulesetDiscovery: After successful account-scoped site read, obtain the actual site/ruleset identity from authoritative provider data; use matching site details or provider dashboard if needed. Do not invent a ruleset identifier.

minimumRemediation: Owner separately authorizes credential restoration. For least-privilege authoritative initial configuration read, use an owner-managed credential restricted to Account Settings Read on only account 8401a673cced362e27f162662ce629ae; no write grants or unrelated account resources. Verify site-list configuration/rules first. Rules-list accepted permission is not explicit, so do not add write permissions merely to test it.
oauthAlternative: Separately authorized Wrangler refresh/reauthentication may restore the existing session, but its historical scope list is broader and Web Analytics read capability remains unproven. No refresh or interactive login performed.
safeLaterSteps: Obtain separate owner authorization for credential creation/restoration; none granted in this diagnosis.
Owner signs into Cloudflare directly and, if choosing a read token, grants Account Settings Read restricted to the intended account only. No Account Settings Write.
Enter any credential only into the approved local secret/environment mechanism outside the repository, such as CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN; never paste it into chat, print it or commit it.
In a later authorized read-only slice, verify authentication and intended-account site configuration visibility; safely derive actual ruleset identity and verify rules read access.
If rules read still fails, record exact evidence and seek provider permission clarification without automatically broadening privileges.
Any analytics mutation or Account Settings Write grant/use requires separate owner authorization.
nextPrerequisite: CLOUDFLARE AUTH RESTORATION — owner-authorized least-privilege credential restoration and authoritative Web Analytics configuration read verification
nextSliceBoundary: Do not resume ZK2 mutation or ZL in this diagnosis. No credential created/replaced/refreshed; no permission changes.
activationQualification: Committed false verified; current live activation not re-read. No activation change performed.
activity: Only local metadata/source review, official public API documentation reads, two credential-in-memory read-only probes and this sanitized artifact. No credential refresh/login/change, permission/config/rule mutation, deployment, source edit, DNS/limiter/D1 change, HIBP call, owner account/password action, FOOD admin change, staging, commit or push.
